**Sample post — this is placeholder content, not a record of a completed project.**

## The idea

Use this space to introduce what you are designing and the problem you want to solve. A few sentences about the requirements and constraints are enough.

## Design notes

- Explain one design decision and why you made it.
- Add a CAD render, sketch, or prototype photo.
- Describe what you measured, checked, or learned.

## Next steps

Finish with the next test or improvement you plan to make. You can also add a link to the same update on LinkedIn.
